name: AGENT-TEST Product Points
test_purpose: Baseline ProductPoints (VIP eligibility) for loyalty suites 075/083 + mixed-cart VCST-5101 (pre-existing).

name: AGENT-TEST PP Single-SKU Laptop
test_purpose: VCST-5135 happy path: ALL customers earn points on ONE product (LT-001). Proves a product factor actually grants points — the dimension the old eligibility-only clones never exercised (they had 0 factors = earned nothing).

name: AGENT-TEST PP Multi-SKU Basket
test_purpose: VCST-5135: points summation across MULTIPLE products with DIFFERENT per-product factors (LT-001=500 / WH-001=50 / QA-TIER-001=25). Asserts per-line accrual sums correctly.

name: AGENT-TEST PP VIP Exclusive
test_purpose: VCST-5135: eligibility COMBINED with real earning — only VIP-group customers earn on WH-001 (non-VIP earns nothing). Eligibility AND a factor

name: AGENT-TEST PP Wholesaler Tier
test_purpose: VCST-5135: group-differentiated earn rate — Wholesaler group earns a different factor (LT-001=250) than the VIP/all programs on the same SKU. Tests group-scoped reward scaling.

name: AGENT-TEST PP Future Window
test_purpose: VCST-5135 lifecycle: start date in the FUTURE (+7d) — program is configured + active flag on + has a factor (WH-001=75) but must NOT accrue until the window opens.

name: AGENT-TEST PP Expired Window
test_purpose: VCST-5135 lifecycle: end date in the PAST (-7d) — expired program with a factor (WH-001=75) must NOT accrue. Negative window coverage.

name: AGENT-TEST PP Inactive With Factors
test_purpose: VCST-5135 negative: isActive=false WITH a real factor present (LT-001=500). Proves the active flag gates earning even when factors exist (distinct from the old 0-factor hollow case).

name: AGENT-TEST PP Priority High
test_purpose: VCST-5135 stacking: a HIGH-priority (100) program on the same SKU as LOY-010 (priority 10) with a larger factor (LT-001=999). Pair with LOY-010 to test which program wins / whether accrual stacks.

name: AGENT-TEST PP Zero Points BVA
test_purpose: VCST-5135 boundary (BVA): a factor explicitly set to 0 points (QA-OOS-001=0). Tests the lower boundary of the points value — a configured-but-zero reward.

name: AGENT-TEST PP Multi Localized
test_purpose: VCST-5135: localized program name (es-ES) + multi-product factor (QA-PACK-001=10 / QA-LOW-001=10). Exercises the Localized names field the old clones never set.
